verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms Mixpanel does offer group-level/account-level analytics suited for B2B SaaS use cases, but notes it is 'tucked away on one of Mixpanel's higher price plans,' limiting access for smaller teams. No first-party documentation in this pack explicitly describes the Group Analytics feature, its setup, or its full capabilities (e.g., analyzing funnels/retention by account rather than user). Missing for 10: first-party docs on Group Analytics/account-level reporting, examples of account-level funnels or retention reports, and independent confirmation the feature works well beyond the pricing-tier gating.
